seoTitle: Buy a GoDaddy Domain and Email Starter Bundle
metaDescription: Get a professional domain and branded email together with GoDaddy's Email Starter bundle. Learn how to register, choose the plan, and set up your inbox.
intro: Bundling a domain with an Email Starter plan is one of the most cost-effective ways to get a professional domain and branded email address set up together on GoDaddy. This guide walks through registering the domain, choosing the email plan, and getting your inbox running.

steps.heading: Search and register a domain name
steps.body: Use GoDaddy's domain search to find and register the domain name you want for your website and email address.

steps.heading: Choose the Email Starter plan
steps.body: Add the Email Starter plan alongside your domain purchase to bundle professional email with your new domain.

steps.heading: Review pricing and billing terms
steps.body: Check the combined pricing for the domain and email bundle, along with renewal terms, before completing checkout.

steps.heading: Activate and set up your professional email
steps.body: Once purchased, activate your new email address and configure your account settings to get it ready for use.

steps.heading: Access your email via webmail or Gmail/Outlook
steps.body: Set up access to your new branded email either through GoDaddy's webmail or by connecting it to Gmail or Outlook.

faq.question: Is the Email Starter plan cheaper than buying email separately?
faq.answer: Bundling with a domain purchase is generally more cost-effective than buying the domain and email plan separately.

faq.question: Can I connect my GoDaddy email to Gmail or Outlook?
faq.answer: Yes, GoDaddy email can be accessed through Gmail or Outlook in addition to its own webmail interface.

faq.question: How many email addresses come with the Starter plan?
faq.answer: The Starter plan typically covers one professional email address, with the option to add more depending on your needs.

faq.question: Do I need to already own a domain to get the bundle?
faq.answer: No, the bundle is designed to let you register a new domain and get email together in a single purchase.
